notes: CONFORMS (2026-11-16, kb/Work PB5857 fixed): item h's RELATIVE KEY item and item i's FILE STATUS item are the same corresponding external data item only when they are the same STORAGE (§2023:14.8.4.2: they "shall refer to the same corresponding storage in each runtime element"): DataItem.ExternalItemIdentity carries the item's character offset (RecordLayout.OffsetOf, the offset the RECORD KEY identity FileEntryIdentity.KeyEntry carries) and width beside its name path, so a same-named item at other character positions of the external record is another item: COBOL1575 for RELATIVE KEY at every edition, COBOL1573 for FILE STATUS at 2023, and the run-time descriptor (OoEmitter) compares the same identity. Witnesses pb5857-external-file-status-other-positions (2023) and the 1985 pair pb5857-external-relative-key-other-positions-85 / -same-positions-85. || CONFORMS, kb/Work PB5733 (fixed): the refusal half holds (entries that disagree are refused COBOL6847), and now the agreeing half holds too: FileRegistry.RegisterIndexed records that a later describer of an existing ::EXT:: connector has its alternate keys already on the shared connector, and AddAlternateKey for that name returns, so the connector keeps one set of alternate keys and the second program's OPEN no longer gets status 39. Witness pb5733_external_alternate_keys_agree (two programs, two alternate keys, one WITH DUPLICATES; READ by the second key). Rule: 'If the file connector referenced by file-name-1 is an external file connector ..., all file control entries in the run unit that reference this file connector shall have:' a)-m) (cite.py --check §2023:12.4.5.3 GR1 OK). FileEntryIdentity.Segments is the one list of the GR1 items an entry specifies; two readers compare it: ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check for the entries of one compilation group at every edition (COBOL6847; the 1985 and 2002 texts state the same rule, §1985:VII.2.3.4 GR1, §2002:12.3.4.3 GR1, and add PADDING CHARACTER), and the run time's EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH between separately compiled elements (FileEntryIdentity.Of into SelectFingerprint, OoEmitter.EmitExternalDescribes, ExternalTable). h) RELATIVE KEY is an external data item and the same one at every edition (COBOL1624, COBOL1575); i) FILE STATUS at 2023 (COBOL1624, COBOL1573). retired-witness: conformance:cases/12.4.5-File-control/w68r_pb1079_external_entry_identity (moved to wiseowl/cases with each called program its own compilation unit (kb/Work PB5069); the row names the new path)
